{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for any orders where `converted == 1` but `status == 'refunded'`
refunded_converted = sales_clean[(sales_clean['converted'] == 1) & (sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded')]

# Print the count
print(f'Number of orders where converted == 1 and status == refunded: {len(refunded_converted)}')

# Check the first few
print(refunded_converted.head())"}
